title: In-repo Gate authorization record (pinned by the AUTHORIZATION ledger event)
description: Factual, agent-authored description of exactly one NOT_STARTED -> AUTHORIZED_NOT_STARTED transition and the Gate's first sealed state revision (R0001). It grants nothing on its own: the granting document is the owner-signed ACTIVE_GATE_AUTHORIZATION_AUTHORITY, joined to this record by a recomputed binding digest. START and execution privilege are not representable. NOTE ON ENFORCEMENT: this repository's canonical schema validator implements a draft-07 SUBSET (type, const, enum, pattern, minLength, minimum, minItems, uniqueItems, required, properties, additionalProperties, items). This schema therefore deliberately avoids $ref/definitions/allOf/contains/maxItems, which would be silently ignored and give a false impression of strictness. The constraints that cannot be expressed here — exact cohort cardinality of 4, exact per-role repository path templates, completeness of prohibitedOperations, and every digest/signature binding — are enforced normatively in governance/gee-v1/core/gate-authorization-authority.mjs and re-enforced permanently in governance/tools/validate-status-ledger.mjs.

authorizedDerivedArtifacts.description: PATH-ONLY by construction. The record is frozen and pinned by the AUTHORIZATION ledger event; the four derived views are regenerated AFTER that event, because regenerating them is what consumes the new ledger state. At the moment these bytes are frozen the post-authorization derived bytes do not exist, so a record declaring their hashes would be claiming to know the future. The owner authority is signed last and carries the full post-authorization derived hashes instead.
